verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a buyer could fairly ask about versioned public APIs. The evidence pack documents no public API, no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the HRIS integration page describes a connector rather than a versioned API with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
